messages:
maya: Heads-up: I’m about to push a config-only deploy for weighted routing by customer_tier + adjusted batching windows. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary 2% traffic to us-east-1 only. Will pin model-version to v2.3 for the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy request received: config-only change (weighted-routing, batch_window, timeout). Requested by maya. ETA start 1726608000. Canary 2% us-east-1. :white_check_mark:

devon: Quick question — what are the exact batching params and timeout deltas? Need to check e2e effect on latency SLOs.

maya: batching: default_window=50ms -> 30ms for premium routes; batch_size cap 64 -> 48 for premium. For standard: window 50ms unchanged but add adaptive cap for spikes: max_burst=128 -> throttle. Timeouts: request_timeout default 10s -> 8s for premium (to fail fast), route-level retry reduced. Weighted routing map:

```
weights:
  premium: 70
  standard: 25
  free: 5
pin_model_version: true
canary_target: "us-east-1"
canary_pct: 2
```

maya: Also adding a temporary KPI alert: if p95 latency for any route increases >5% vs baseline for 15m, auto-rollback triggers. If error-rate >1% absolute increase for 10m also triggers.

liam: Sounds reasonable. How are we going to monitor KV cache pressure? Adaptive batching might increase kvcache churn.

sana: I’ll add a short eval to the console: run the golden prompt set against canary for 30m and compare token regs. Will post results in the thread.

jen: Can we scope the canary to a small set of test API keys (internal) instead of pure percentage? Less blast radius.

maya: Good call. Doing both: 2% live traffic + include internal keys (team-qa-*) in the canary bucket. That way we get production signals + controlled keys.

devon: Rollback playbook? If deploy-bot auto-rollback fails, what's manual command and who owns escalation?

maya: Rollback plan: 1) deploy-bot auto-rollback on KPI breach. 2) If auto fails, oncall paged (ops-bot alert to #eng-oncall). 3) Manual rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback config 1726604321 --immediate` (owner: devops oncall). 4) Postmortem if rollback occurs.

ops-bot: Alerting rule added: p95-route-latency delta >5% (15m) -> page @oncall and post to #incidents. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rolling-config-rollback

deploy-bot: scheduled: start=1726608000, canary_pct=2, canary_region=us-east-1, pinned_model=v2.3. I will report canary metrics every 5m in this thread. :robot_face:

sana: kicking off golden set now, will post latency + quality deltas at +10m and +30m.

liam: FYI I updated the routing policy code to respect the new weight map; added guard so older agents still route to default if header missing.

maya: Thanks — going to start the rollout at the window. If no major regressions by +30m, we bump to 10% for 30m then 50% next hour.

jen: leaving a :thumbsup: and will watch logs for KV spikes. Good luck.

deploy-bot: canary started (1726608000). Reporting cadence enabled.
